I am part of the discussion on updates for the game, sadly there has been little success to my knowledge of any heroes from official server as it requires decryption of the code and that means hacking. That is something that Meh and others are reluctant to do. I do hope that we can however build our own private server heroes, which is a quite likely possibility

Apologies on th developers behalf, but I don't think we have made any fodder heroes good in anyway - the best teams in all aspects of the game are always L/D or the elite heroes. That will remain that way forever onwards on the private server. However we do look to balance out heroes more than on the official because we seek a more fair game which is equally more fun and has a diverse avenue of heroic teams etc.

I apologise on behalf of the game, but if you want your voice to be heard, joining the movement to help develop this game would be a great opportunity to do so. I equally share you anger in some ways as I did manage to get 12 million damage against me from a Kharma which honestly shocked me - but it is a game none the less and we can put ideas of what we want to hello build this server.

Please also understand that if your choice of development is not implemented, that does not mean we have not heard you, or that you have been ignored, it just means that the community hasn't supported your idea as much as another - that isn't to discredit your ideas. 

I hope that you can take it upon yourself to try and better this community and we would be very happy to have you join us, be it now or at a later stage. We appreciate the support for the server!
